name: OpenTelemetry GenAI
summary: The OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions define standard span, metric and event attributes for generative AI: model inference calls, token usage, agent operations (such as create_agent and invoke_agent) and MCP. Instrumenting against them lets any OpenTelemetry-compatible backend read LLM and agent traces without vendor-specific SDKs. The conventions now live in their own repository and are still marked Development.
facts: Inference, agent spans, MCP, token metrics
Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Inference
goodFor: Avoiding lock-in to one tracing vendor
Sending agent traces to existing observability stacks
Mixing frameworks under one trace format
watchOut: Development status: attribute names can still change
Message content capture is opt-in and raises privacy questions
